experiment_data.hypothesis: DC-GRPO with scaled cosine R1 (scale_factor=5, r1_weight=0.4, r3_weight=0.6). Cosine similarity in 4096-dim space is inherently small (gap ~0.098), contributing only ~8% of combined reward at default scale. Scaling by 5x amplifies R1 gap to ~0.49, making R1 contribute ~45% of combined reward alongside R3. If scaled R1 shows learning trend and improves sycophancy reduction over R3-only (exp-003), this validates that direction-projection provides meaningful training signal when properly scaled.
